name: Ground-vehicle strawberry and blueberry yield prediction

mentions.name: Ground-vehicle strawberry and blueberry yield prediction
mentions.description: This project performs crop yield prediction using a ground vehicle fitted with cameras on top that drives between strawberry and blueberry plants.
mentions.problem: Yield prediction accuracy is financially critical: overshooting the prediction means selling produce at a lower price, while undershooting means paying for someone's product to make up the difference.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm also involved in a project to do yield prediction, but with a ground-vehicle with camera's on top to drive between strawberry and blueberry plants.

evidence.value: I'm also involved in a project to do yield prediction, but with a ground-vehicle with camera's on top to drive between strawberry and blueberry plants.
